issues.description: Class name in code (AWSAgentCoreProcessor) does not match PR title (AWSBedrockAgentCoreProcessor) and is exported via wildcard without __all__
issues.detail: PR title advertises AWSBedrockAgentCoreProcessor but the implementation defines AWSAgentCoreProcessor. The module is re-exported via `from .agent_core import *` with no __all__, leaking internal helpers (default_context_to_payload_transformer, default_response_to_output_transformer, json, os, asyncio) into the public namespace. Pick the canonical name and define __all__.

issues.description: agentArn parameter uses camelCase, breaking PEP 8 / project naming conventions
issues.detail: All other constructor parameters use snake_case (aws_access_key, aws_region), but `agentArn` is camelCase. This is a public API and will be painful to change later. Rename to `agent_arn` before this ships.

issues.description: Bedrock client recreated on every LLMContextFrame, adding latency and breaking long sessions
issues.detail: `async with self._aws_session.client(...)` opens a fresh aiobotocore client per invocation inside process_frame. For a streaming voice agent this adds TLS/handshake overhead per turn. Create the client once during setup (or cache it) and close on cleanup, instead of per-frame.

issues.description: default_response_to_output_transformer will raise on non-JSON lines, killing the stream
issues.detail: `json.loads(response_line)` has no try/except. AgentCore streams often include keepalives, empty events, or non-JSON `data:` lines; any one of them will raise JSONDecodeError out of process_frame and abort the pipeline. Wrap in try/except and log+skip, mirroring the warning pattern used for malformed `data:` lines.

issues.description: LLMFullResponseEndFrame can fire after the next LLMFullResponseStartFrame due to unawaited close task
issues.detail: _close_output_response_after_timeout sleeps 1s then pushes End. If a new context arrives within 1s, process_frame opens a new Start without cancelling the pending close task (cancellation only happens inside _push_text_frame). The stale timer then pushes End mid-response, corrupting bookends. Cancel the close task at the top of process_frame for context frames.

issues.description: Streamed SSE parsing assumes one event per line and silently drops multi-line data fields and event boundaries
issues.detail: SSE events are delimited by blank lines and may span multiple `data:` lines that should be concatenated. Splitting only on `\n` and treating each `data:` line as a complete JSON response will mis-parse legitimate multi-line events and ignore `event:`/`id:` fields. Consider a proper SSE parser or document the narrow expected format.

review.summary: The new AWSAgentCoreProcessor has several real issues before merge: a name mismatch with the PR title plus a wildcard re-export with no __all__, a camelCase public parameter (agentArn) inconsistent with the rest of the API, a Bedrock client constructed per frame, a default JSON transformer that will crash on non-JSON SSE lines, a race in the response-bookend timer that can emit End mid-response, and a naive SSE parser. None of these are security issues, but the first two will be hard to change after release, and the runtime correctness bugs will bite the first real streaming agent.
